profile.name: Lauren Fischer
profile.summary: HR specialist with five years supporting 300 to 600 employees in manufacturing and health care. Most of my work is recruiting, onboarding and employee relations. SHRM-CP.

descriptions: Handle full-cycle hiring for about 90 roles a year across two plants; time to fill dropped from 41 days to 27
Rebuilt onboarding into a two-week plan with checklists for managers; first-90-day turnover fell from 24% to 13%
Investigate and document employee relations cases and advise supervisors on leave, accommodation and discipline
Moved personnel files and time-off requests into BambooHR for 480 employees
Scheduled about 60 interviews a week for nursing and caregiver roles and ran Saturday hiring events
Set up text reminders for candidates, which cut interview no-shows by about a third
Kept the applicant tracking system clean and sent weekly pipeline reports to hiring managers
